    if not probe.get("connect_ok", False): return "connect_failure"

    return "route_healthy"

def checks(files):
    suffixes = {name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() for name in files if "." in name}
    result = []
    if "py" in suffixes: result += ["python -m compileall", "python -m pytest"]
    if suffixes & {"js", "ts"}: result += ["npm test", "npm run lint"]
    if "java" in suffixes: result += ["mvn test"]
    if "cs" in suffixes: result += ["dotnet test"]
    if suffixes & {"html", "htm"}: result += ["html validation"]
    return result
